old_problem: The historical review treated the setter, byte encoding and time-basis behavior as undefined. IPMI 2.0 section 31.11b and Appendix G define Set SEL Time UTC Offset as optional Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Dh with exactly two little-endian bytes containing signed minutes, range -1440 through +1440, or 07FFh for unspecified. Section 31.11a provides mandatory 5Ch readback when 5Dh exists. The safe target value, chronology window and exact baseline restore remain Project-controlled parameters, not a reason to keep standard command semantics Pending.
disposition_reason: Preserve the raw SEL and time baseline, read the complete current offset with 0Ah/5Ch, encode one distinct owner-approved target as two little-endian bytes for 0Ah/5Dh, obtain explicit confirmation, write once, require 5Ch exact readback, prove the SEL clock itself and raw existing records were not rewritten, then restore the exact baseline with one approved 5Dh write and verify it. Contain consumers because changing the offset changes the UTC interpretation of SEL local timestamps. Coordinate the DST/time owner and prohibit Set SEL Time 49h, which independently resets the offset to 07FFh. Unsupported is N/A only from authoritative platform evidence; no value, margin, retry, log clear or repair action may be guessed.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1078-1080 and 1084, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. tests.json contains one occurrence of this code. The related OOB setter is row 1206 / variant 30095b90395e299a and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 74 was independently verified as row 1084 / variant c24d080be22f3673.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Set SEL Time UTC Offset to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Dh. Section 31.11b specifies exactly two request bytes, least-significant byte first, containing a 16-bit two's-complement number of minutes from UTC to SEL Time.

Normal values range from -1440 to +1440 minutes. 07FFh is a distinct unspecified sentinel, meaning SEL time is interpreted as local time; it must be recognized before ordinary signed-range validation.

The normative sign is operationally testable: SEL local time equals UTC plus offset, while UTC equals SEL time minus offset. The standard also warns that daylight-saving changes can require software to update the offset, so the time-sync owner and exact test instant matter.
Get 0Ah/5Ch returns the stored two-byte value and is mandatory when Set 5Dh is implemented. Completion of 5Dh alone is not PASS; exact 5Ch readback is required after target and restore writes.

Executing Set SEL Time 0Ah/49h automatically resets the UTC offset to 07FFh for backward compatibility. It is therefore prohibited inside this case and cannot be used as a restore shortcut; concurrent software that invokes 49h is a race requiring containment.

The offset is metadata associated with SEL Time. A 5Dh write should not rewrite raw existing SEL record bytes or the SEL clock, but it can change how consumers convert their local timestamps to UTC. Immutable pre/post record capture and a bounded, isolated consumer window protect chronology evidence.

A meaningful setter test must use a distinct approved TARGET_OFFSET, not merely rewrite baseline. The target may be another valid signed-minute value or 07FFh only when the Project explicitly approves that state and its temporary chronology impact.

ED-03 permits the standardized command but not OEM substitutions; ED-15 prohibits an invented acceptance margin; ED-17 protects SEL evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require safe recovery; ED-34 parameterizes target/time policy; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Set SEL Time UTC Offset (IB Storage 0Ah/5Dh) controlled chronology change, 5Ch readback and exact restore
test_case.purpose: Set one distinct approved SEL UTC-offset value through the local IPMI interface, validate exact standard encoding, readback and bounded chronology interpretation, then restore the original field without rewriting SEL records, changing the SEL clock, clearing evidence or substituting the OOB variant.
required_package: Approved BMC/firmware and local IPMI interface with authoritative 5Dh support; version-pinned raw writer/reader preserving exact request, completion, stderr and response bytes
Complete 5Ch baseline classified as signed minutes or 07FFh, an exact distinct TARGET_OFFSET_MINUTES or approved TARGET_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH, and precomputed BASE/TARGET little-endian bytes
Time/BMC owner, incident/compliance clearance, maintenance window, downstream SEL consumer inventory and explicit immediate confirmation for the target write and exact baseline restore
Immutable raw SEL export/hash, SEL Info and SEL Time baseline, trusted UTC reference, named timezone/DST state, and Project-approved clock-skew threshold for chronology checks
Containment proving no concurrent Set SEL Time 49h, DST updater or other offset writer can race the test; independent OOB recovery visibility without using the OOB setter as this case's evidence
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED CHRONOLOGY-AFFECTING PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Record Source Key/variant and target identity; export/hash raw SEL records and capture SEL Info, 0Ah/48h SEL Time, trusted UTC and 0Ah/5Ch BASE bytes without clearing logs. Decode BASE using the 5Ch sentinel-first rules. Require no incident hold, no active writer/49h clock-sync race, isolated consumers, approved skew, and a distinct approved TARGET. Encode a signed target as U=TARGET_OFFSET_MINUTES&0xFFFF, LO=U&0xFF, HI=(U>>8)&0xFF; encode unspecified only as FF 07. Unit-check the encoder offline (for example +480=E0 01, -480=20 FE, +1440=A0 05, -1440=60 FA). Display BASE, TARGET, expected interpretation and exact restore bytes for immediate confirmation. Send once: `ipmitool -I open raw 0x0a 0x5d 0xLO 0xHI`. Require completion 00h, then one `ipmitool -I open raw 0x0a 0x5c` read with exact TARGET bytes. Re-read 48h and raw SEL evidence; require clock continuity within the approved threshold, no existing raw record rewrite and the calculated `SEL local = UTC + target` interpretation when target is specified. Send exact BASE bytes once, require completion 00h and 5Ch exact BASE readback, then verify clock continuity, SEL integrity and consumer release. Never call 49h, clear logs, alter host time, retry, or use row 1206 OOB output as IB coverage.
test_case.expected_result: The target 5Dh request has exactly two correctly encoded bytes and completes 00h; immediate 5Ch returns those exact bytes and decodes to the approved target. The SEL clock remains continuous within the approved skew, raw existing SEL records remain byte-identical except separately explained concurrent additions, and consumer interpretation follows the documented UTC/local relationship. The exact baseline 5Dh restore completes 00h, 5Ch equals BASE, chronology checks return to baseline and no logs are cleared. Unsupported 5Dh is N/A only with authoritative platform evidence. Any mismatch, race, record rewrite, unapproved chronology change or incomplete restore is FAIL and stops further action.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact IB identity, verified target and 5Dh capability, immutable baseline, a distinct approved target, correct two-byte signed/sentinel encoding, explicit confirmation, target completion plus exact 5Ch readback, no raw-record or SEL-clock corruption, approved chronology comparison, exact BASE restore and final 5Ch/integrity proof. FAIL covers wrong sign/endian/range, command success without readback, unexpected 49h/DST-writer race, raw record rewrite, consumer impact outside containment, target/baseline mismatch, automatic retry or restore failure. NOT READY covers absent support evidence, baseline, target, threshold, ownership, containment, approval or recovery. N/A requires authoritative lack of 5Dh support; a generic command error alone cannot establish it.
safety_gate: This state change requires a dedicated maintenance window, incident/compliance clearance, time/BMC-owner control and immediate approval after the exact two target bytes and restore bytes are displayed.
Preserve and hash raw SEL records before any write. Never follow the source boilerplate's clear-log step; do not delete records or suppress evidence to simplify comparison.
Stop or coordinate every automatic offset/DST writer and prohibit concurrent Set SEL Time 49h. A 49h call resets offset to 07FFh and invalidates target/readback/recovery attribution.
Use one distinct Project-approved value only. Do not probe boundaries on the DUT, guess a timezone, infer from host configuration, or accept an unapproved clock-skew threshold.
Use local `-I open` only for this identity. OOB observation may support recovery visibility but cannot satisfy row 1079 or authorize row 1206's separate setter.

No automatic retry. On target failure or ambiguity, capture 5Ch once; restore BASE once only under the preapproved recovery when state actually changed and the chronology owner confirms it is safe. On failed restore, freeze further time/log actions and escalate.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant, BMC/firmware/local-interface identity, official 31.11a/31.11b and Appendix G authority, 5Dh capability and separate OOB identity
Immutable pre-write raw SEL export/hash, SEL Info, 48h SEL Time, trusted UTC, 5Ch BASE raw/decoded value and competing-writer containment
Approved distinct target, timezone/DST interpretation, skew, maintenance/incident clearance, immediate confirmation and precomputed target/restore bytes
Versioned writer hash, exact 5Dh target request/completion, immediate 5Ch raw equality and signed/sentinel decode
Target-state clock continuity, calculated chronology interpretation, raw-record integrity and downstream consumer audit
Exact 5Dh BASE restore/completion, final 5Ch BASE equality, final time/SEL/consumer integrity and explicit PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A; record that the review agent performed no DUT action
test_case.recovery: Retain BASE bytes and exact 5Dh restore command before authorization. If the target write fails, read 5Ch once and stop; if BASE is unchanged, do not write again. If state changed or is ambiguous, the owner may send the preapproved BASE bytes once, then require 5Ch equality, SEL-time continuity, raw-record integrity and consumer recovery. Never use 49h, host clock changes, SEL clear, BMC reset or OOB setter as an improvised restore. If baseline cannot be proven, preserve all evidence, quarantine chronology produced during the window and escalate without retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the setter, payload, readback, range, sentinel and clock interaction. The review layer replaces the unsafe TBD/log-clear boilerplate with an evidence-preserving, explicitly authorized target/readback/restore workflow.

project_authority: The BMC/time and incident owners bind supported firmware, baseline, a distinct target, timezone/DST/skew oracle, competing-writer containment, maintenance window, consumers, exact restore and verdict. They cannot redefine encoding, waive immutable SEL evidence, use an unapproved threshold, treat completion without 5Ch as PASS, merge OOB coverage, permit automatic retry or use 49h/log clearing as recovery.
